listed_quote.quote: The Fund's Board of Trustees has approved a proposal to reorganize the Fund into a newly created closed-end interval fund (the "Interval Fund").

announcement.quote: Invesco Advisers Announces Plans for Reorganization and Tender Offer for Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunities Fund

outcome_evidence.quote: announced today the completion of the reorganization (the “Reorganization”) of Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunities Fund (NYSE: VTA) (the “Fund”) into a newly created closed-end interval fund, Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunity Fund (the “Interval Fund”).

deals.notes: Acquirer is a newly created interval fund (quarterly repurchase offers, not exchange traded), so not a listed pair. The reorganization was approved by shareholders on September 3, 2021 (0001137439-21-000749) and completed 2021-11-01 (0001137439-21-001093); VTA ceased trading on the NYSE after October 28, 2021. A 20 percent cash tender offer ran in parallel. Acquirer share-class ticker XAXCX appears in a table but is not given as the fund ticker, so left null.
